text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a ~12% p99 regression on seq > 512 after yesterday's autotune change. Trace shows more Triton->CUTLASS fallbacks on H100 for long sequences.
kevin: Which model and batch sizes? Any KV cache differences?
maria: quick snippet from profiler:
```
model: redwood-7b
seq: 1024
batch: 1
kernel_path: triton -> fallback cutlass
p99_latency_ms: 210 (baseline) -> 235 (post-change)
probe_score: 0.47
```
sam: That matches my hunch — the probe sampler was dominated by short-seq samples (80% <=64). Autotuner looks greedy: picks kernel that wins current probe set, not the heavy-tail of long seqs.
jun: We hit sampling bias last week. Two quick mitigations: stratified probing by seq buckets, and add a recency-weighted decay so recent long-seq observations influence decisions faster. Also a small predictive model (seq_len, batch, kv_hit_rate, GPU_arch) could pick kernel path instead of pure greedy score.
maria: Can someone check KV cache hit rate in the traces? If KV is cold then some CUTLASS kernels are worse for latency because of memory moves.
olga: Note: CUTLASS path on H100 uses a different memory layout that performs much better for seqlen>512, but only if KV is warmed and continuous batching doesn't smash the layout assumptions. There might be an interaction with our batching heuristics (continuous batching probe).
kevin: Perf-bot uploaded the nightly probe summary — perf-bot: nightly_autotune_report.pdf attached in #eng-runtime (see uploaded artifacts).
perf-bot: nightly_autotune_report.pdf (summary) — top concern: seq>256 sample density fell from 13% -> 4% after probe config change.
sam: Proposal: run a canary forcing predictive routing for 24h for traffic with median seq>256. Compare p99 and tail variance. I'll schedule on canary pool.
jun: And add a short-term patch to require N consecutive better samples before switching kernel for a path (hysteresis). This prevents flips due to noisy probes.
kevin: Also add structured logging: kernel_choice_reason: [probe_score, predicted_latency_ms, seq_bucket]. We can query these in Console and tie to rollout.
maria: Good. Let’s assign: sam -> run canary and collect traces; kevin -> implement kernel_choice_reason logs; jun -> prototype stratified probe + hysteresis; olga -> validate CUTLASS memory layout notes and see if batching heuristics need guardrails.
deploy-bot: canary started on pool 'canary-h100-2' with config autotune.mode=predictive, probe.stratify=true
maria: Thanks all — reconvene in ~2h with canary numbers. If p99 improves we either rollback the greedy sampler or ship stratified probing + hysteresis. Also create an alert on Console: p99 delta > 8% within 1h.
kevin: ack. I'll add the alert and a dashboard card to break down kernel_choice_reason by seq_bucket.
maria: quick note: keep the default path unchanged for non-canary traffic; we only toggle for the canary pool.
sam: starting canary run now, will post a short summary once we have 1k long-seq requests.
